text:
maya: quick heads-up — ran a short canary comparing p50/p95 across regions with edge routing vs direct for the new quantized-1.2 model. numbers below, surprised by the eu-west tail 😕

chris: drop the numbers? that sounds high. which hardware?

maya: H100 pool for canary; also did an A100 run. sample size ~1.8k requests per region, 512 tokens avg.

maya: US-EAST (direct): p50 38ms, p95 98ms
maya: US-EAST (via edge): p50 44ms, p95 118ms (+20ms tail)

maya: US-WEST (direct): p50 46ms, p95 135ms
maya: US-WEST (via edge): p50 53ms, p95 186ms (+51ms tail)

maya: EU-WEST (direct): p50 72ms, p95 210ms
maya: EU-WEST (via edge): p50 80ms, p95 265ms (+55ms tail) — big bump on tail when routed through our edge proxy stack.

david: hmm looks like extra hop + TLS termination + kernel mismatch is compounding. did you check kernel selection?

maya: yes — default kernel path picks "attn-fused-v2" on H100, but when routed via edge proxy we fall back to "attn-vanilla" for some reason (seen in logs). that fallback adds ~10–30ms depending on seq len.

maya: quick log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] request-id=rid_9c3 kernel=attn-vanilla region=eu-west route=edge-proxy hop_count=3
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] request-id=rid_9c4 kernel=attn-fused-v2 region=us-east route=direct hop_count=1
```

chris: that aligns. also saw quantized-1.2 p95 degrade ~8ms compared to fp16 on EU-WEST. likely extra memcpy/format conversion when edge-proxy toggles qint path.

david: action items: 1) add kernel affinity tag so edge-proxy route preserves kernel selection if compatible. 2) run microbench on A100 vs H100 with same kernel to isolate hw delta. 3) consider sticky-route for eu-west high-tail traffic.

maya: minimal routing config I tested (canary):
```
route_policies:
  - name: preserve-kernel-if-compatible
    match: {
      region: eu-west,
      model: quantized-1.2
    }
    action: keep_kernel_affinity: true
```

infra-bot: canary started: id=canary-20654321, targets=[us-east,us-west,eu-west], replicas=12, window=30m

chris: good. also benched kernel swap on H100: attn-fused-v2 => p95 down by ~12ms across regions, p50 down ~4ms. on A100 fused kernel helps but smaller delta (~6ms p95).

maya: so immediate mitigation: enable kernel affinity for canary and disable edge path for eu-west heavy flows for next 24h. will monitor p95 and error-rate.

david: +1. can you post the dashboard snapshots when you have them? add p50/p95 lines and a hop_count distribution.

maya: will do — pushing dashboard snapshot now and scheduling a short follow-up sync if tail persists. :thumbsup:
